name: orc_r113_power_to_power_ratio
title: R113 power-to-power ratio of an ORC and a heat pump (example)
summary: Teaching example for an R113 installation. The ORC turbine electrical power follows from a given enthalpy drop of 17.5 kJ/kg. The heat-pump compressor electrical power follows from the saturated evaporator exit and a condenser inlet superheated by 5 °C. The model computes the absolute power-to-power ratio of those two AC powers.
